{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_real = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_real['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
